title: Türkiye Energy Intelligence Platform
description: An open-source platform for Turkish electricity-market data ingestion, quality control, time-series analytics, forecasting, anomaly detection, visualization and BI-ready exports. Version 1.1.0 introduces a secure hosted Streamlit mode for authenticated official EPİAŞ consumption, generation-by-source and market-clearing-price data, with private credentials stored only in Streamlit Secrets. The reproducible synthetic demo remains available without registration.
